content.short: DigitalEyes Market is a Solana NFT marketplace.
content.description: DigitalEyes Market operates as a Solana-based NFT marketplace where users can browse, search, filter, and trade Solana NFTs in a single interface. The platform also allows developers to apply to launch new collections and download their mint hash lists. By October 22, 2022, DigitalEyes reported more than 71,000 traders using the market and a cumulative trading volume exceeding $127 million, reflecting active participation and liquidity in the ecosystem.
